verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a real third-party ecosystem: Meta's docs point to Llama.cpp for running Llama on varied hardware, and list many hosting and distribution partners, including Hugging Face, Groq and the major clouds. Community comments say Llama is offered as a first-class option across major hosting providers and predict it will 'spread like wildfire.' Missing for 10: curated community lists (e.g. awesome-lists), routers/aggregators, evidence of active maintainer activity on third-party tools, and independent hands-on corroboration of ecosystem health.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers

citations.quote: Llama.cpp - Uses the portability of C++ to enable inference with Llama models on a variety of different hardware.

Models are also hosted and distributed by partners such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, IBM Watsonx, Oracle Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, Dell, Hugging Face, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova, and many others.
It is offered as a first class LLM option in AWS, Azure, GCP and all other major hosting providers.
